split.engine: atx mm-replay (crates/atx/src/mm_replay.rs): ob200 snapshot + deltas -> at_match::Ob200Replayer -> at_match::OrderBook; public trade tape merged by time (trade ts <= message cts first); the live atx mm decision code (mm::symbol_inputs, mm::target_quotes, mm::needs_replace, sigma / flow / micro / toxicity / shock / trend-guard steps); our orders virtual (minimum lots, no impact)
split.queue: join the back at activation (ahead = level size); trades at our price consume from the front; trade through our price or a real resting order crossing our price fills us; unexplained level decreases are cancels split FIFO-pessimistic (behind first), pro-rata (primary), LIFO-optimistic (ahead first); levels outside the 200-level window count fully ahead when they appear; RPI prints do not fill
split.fees: config/fees.yaml by symbol class (crypto: maker 2.0 bp, taker 5.5 bp)
split.risk: inventory caps, per-symbol and global loss stops from the config (a stop cancels and closes at market, taker); one-lot-from-flat rule
split.day: each symbol-day starts flat at 00:00 UTC and is marked to the mid at 24:00 UTC; warm-up 1m bars of the two previous days
split.pnl: net = spread captured + adverse selection (60 s) + inventory P&L - fees; spread = sum s q (mid_fill - price); adverse_h = sum s q (mid_t+h - mid_fill) (1 / 10 / 60 s); inventory = sum s q (mid_end - mid_t+60s)
split.selection: per group, on FIT days only, pro-rata queue: combinatorial purged CV over days (10 fit days, 2 test days per split = 45 splits, training days within 1 calendar day of a test day purged); a variant's CV score = median over splits of its test-day mean net P&L per symbol-day; choice = the highest CV score (H-MMR1); best fixed width = the F variant chosen the same way among F only, best micro among M, best forecast among N (H-MMR2)
split.overfitting: PBO by CSCV over the fit days (S = 10 one-day blocks, C(10,5) = 252 splits, metric = mean net P&L per symbol-day); deflated Sharpe of the chosen variant's daily net P&L on fit days with N = grid size trials
split.tests: H-MMR1: mean net P&L per symbol-day on HELD days, day-clustered bootstrap (B = 10000) 95% CI, per group, pro-rata primary; H-MMR2: paired per symbol-day difference (forecast - best fixed) on HELD days, day-clustered bootstrap; H-MMR0: live days with the journaled live config over the live window, |replay - live| / max(live, 1) fill-count error and P&L sign agreement
split.segment: every day is after research.knowledge_cutoff (2026-07-01): clean_holdout
split.forecast: N family: the BTC live network's 1h band (data/journal/live_nn net.1h.sigma_pct) where it exists (2026-11-13 20:00-24:00 UTC); every other hour the field's hour-of-week x log-vol sigma sqrt(vf_t * f_next) (ai_trader.field.state; hour-of-week profile known at the day's 00:00 UTC; row valid from its known_ts)
